items.stem: Which access tier is optimized for data accessed infrequently and retained at least 30 days?

options.rationale: Correct: the cool tier suits infrequently accessed data with a 30-day minimum retention.
Hot is for frequently accessed data with higher storage cost.
Archive is offline with a 180-day minimum, for rarely accessed data.
Premium is a performance tier, not an access tier for retention.

items.explanation: Correct: the cool tier suits infrequently accessed data with a 30-day minimum retention.

items.stem: Which TWO are valid Azure Storage redundancy options? (Select TWO.)

options.rationale: Correct: LRS replicates within a single datacentre.
Correct: GRS replicates to a secondary region.
Conditional Access is an Entra feature, not a redundancy option.
Focused Inbox is an Outlook feature, not a storage redundancy option.

items.explanation: Correct: LRS replicates within a single datacentre.

items.stem: On which blob type can you set an access tier?

options.rationale: Correct: setting an access tier is only supported on block blobs.
Append blobs do not support access-tier settings.
Page blobs do not support access-tier settings.
Only block blobs support access tiers.
